replies.content:
⚡ MEMEPOOL MEME TOURNAMENT #1

Let's kick things off with something casual: 10 days, 1 BSV for each of the top five memes.
No forms, no "here is my entry" replies. Just create memes.

Launch a memecoin at https://txblaster.xyz/memepool name, ticker, image and social media links if you wish.  It costs 50,000 sats plus the byte size of your image, recorded on-chain during deployment. Any coin launched before October 14 at 23:59 UTC is automatically entered. You can launch as many as you like.

The meme itself is what gets judged: the name, ticker, image, and short story (a single line). Not the price chart. A coin that no one has bought can still win, and pumping your own coin gains you nothing.

Open theme.

On October 15, TX Blaster will select the three winners and send 1 BSV to each creator, directly to the address used to launch the coin (the same one that receives creation fees). There is nothing to claim and nothing to post.

Your coin generates profits for you anyway: 0.30% of every trade involving it goes to your wallet—within the same transaction—for as long as the coin is being traded.

Memecoins are toys. Spend only what you are willing to lose.

replies.content:
MEMEPOOL just got a lot bigger. 8 new things, all live now at txblaster.xyz/memepool

⚡ ADVANCED — every coin in three live columns: just launched, about to graduate, graduated. Sparkline, holders, dev % and a quick-buy button on every row. It asks before each buy until you arm one-click yourself.

🎁 REWARDS — see what your wallet earned from each coin: pending, paid, with the txids. Plus a ranking of the coins that pay their holders and burn the most.

🏆 LEADERS — top traders by realized profit and top creators by volume. 24h, 7d, 30d, all time. The house market maker and vault buybacks never count.

💼 MY COINS — a real portfolio: what each position cost you, what it would pay if you sold right now, profit and loss per coin, and your rewards.

👤 PROFILES + FOLLOW — every wallet has a page. Follow the ones you like and get a feed of what they buy, sell and launch.

⭐ WATCHLIST + ALERTS — star any coin, set a price alert, get pinged when it graduates or pays out.

🔎 BOARD FILTERS — filter by where a coin's creator fee goes: holder rewards, burn, split or buyback. Sort by rewards paid or supply burned.

📖 HOW IT WORKS — the curve, the fees and the five fee routes on one page, with live numbers. 1.25% per trade, 0.30% of it is the creator's share to keep, split, burn or hand to holders.
Every trade is still an atomic swap on-chain, signed in your own wallet.
Go break it and tell me what you find 👇

https://txblaster.xyz/memepool
